propositions: ADF is hardwired into Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup; the RichTextCodec Protocol must abstract both with four distinct operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) to preserve existing caller behavior

Cloud path has two distinct call patterns that cannot be collapsed: _fit_description composes both fit and normalize in order, while sanitize_description uses fit only; collapsing them into a single operation would change observable behavior

map_fields_to_remote currently has duplicate implementations in backend.py and must be relocated to a single shared implementation in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py (Cloud side) not jira_family to preserve J2's import contract forbidding jira_family from importing vendor modules

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767 with marker ' … [truncated by reconciler]' and both codecs must pass a shared contract test covering fit, normalize, wire, and decode operations
no new direct ADF references outside codec implementations must be introduced; existing pinned locations (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, inbound seam) remain unchanged
